verdict.rationale: A business filing and registry portal could plausibly offer scheduled recurring filings or automated renewals, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no user-configurable scheduling of jobs or workflows. The 'Data and Image Subscriptions' and 'Farm Product Monthly Subscription' offerings are vendor-defined recurring data products, an adjacent feature rather than the ability to schedule your own recurring jobs, and the filing rail is a login-gated manual portal.
